title: Cohesion Week Ops Playbook and Staff Brief (Q1 launch prep)
summary: Working playbook for the company-wide "cohesion week" that finalizes Q1 OKRs, frames the executive update, and scripts the all-hands. This is a working draft: focuses on high-impact alignment, comms cadence, rehearsal plan, and open decisions. Notes-to-self: keep the first 10 minutes of all-hands focused on wins + 3 northstar asks, keep Q&A structured (product/eng/cs buckets).
proposed_okrs: Objective A: Reduce hosted inference 95th p99 latency variability across critical endpoints by 30% vs baseline (Jan).
KR A1: Deploy two runtime kernel improvements to production canary by 2026-01-20 and measure 95th p99 delta for 5 representative models.
KR A2: Implement request-level prefix caching for high-reuse routes and validate 10% aggregate token cost reduction by Feb end.
Objective B: Improve developer adoption and time-to-first-call for Redwood API by 40%.
KR B1: Ship new quickstart templates (chat, embeddings, reranker) with sample apps and automated tests by 2026-01-15.
KR B2: Reduce SDK install + hello-world -> first call median time from 18m to 8m (measure via onboarding funnel).
Objective C: Enterprise readiness for Private deployments—close security and compliance integration gaps.
KR C1: Complete KMS/HSM SOC2 control mapping and publish customer-facing checklist by 2026-02-01.
KR C2: Pilot two on-prem installs with early-adopter customers and produce runbook updates by 2026-03-01.
allhands_agenda: 00:00–00:05: Opening + intro (CEO) — 3 quick wins since last all-hands
00:05–00:15: State of the product (Head of Product) — 90s on hosted, dedicated, private highlights
00:15–00:25: Ops & Reliability snapshot (SRE lead) — latency/cost trends + what we did to stabilize
00:25–00:35: Developer adoption story (DevX lead) — demo of new quickstart + metrics
00:35–00:45: Customer spotlight (CS) — short prerecorded clip + live Q&A
00:45–00:55: OKR callouts and asks (Company Ops) — 3 company asks for Q1 and how teams opt in
00:55–01:10: Live Q&A — structured to product/engineering/sales buckets
01:10–01:15: Closing + next steps (CEO) — rehearsal notes for follow-ups
comms_plan: Pre-comm (1 week out): short 'what to expect' note from CEO + link to this doc and PRD cores
Reminder (2 days out): calendar update with meeting times, rehearsal blocks, and speaker checklist
Post-all-hands: publish recording, annotated transcript, and action tracker (Confluence + Slack #company-updates)
Follow-up cadence: Owners to post weekly 1-paragraph updates for first 6 weeks of Q1 on progress toward OKRs
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Last-minute infra regression during canary could delay KR A1 — Mitigation: freeze unrelated deploys 48h prior and have rollback playbook ready
Risk: Overloaded keynote with too many metrics — Mitigation: prioritize 3 signals (latency, cost per 1k tokens, developer first-call time) and surface deeper metrics in linked dashboards
Risk: Customer pilot for Private gets blocked by networking constraints — Mitigation: pre-check network diagram and allocate SRE/solutions engineer pair for onsite support
decisions_needed: Decision 1: Final Q1 OKR wording and owners — need exec approval by 2025-11-18
Decision 2: Commitment level for hiring freeze vs bump for infra SRE hires — recommendation to approve 2 critical roles this quarter
Decision 3: Public metrics baseline and thresholds for declaring KR progress — agree on measurement windows

rehearsal_notes: Dry-run script: start with CEO 30s 3-win opener, then hand-off to Product with 60s top-line. Speakers must have 1 slide and 1 measurable ask. Rehearsals scheduled in 30m blocks; mandatory for execs and owners. Checklist: mic test, slide notes in speaker view, two backup slides for outages. Post-rehearsal to-do: each owner add 3 bullet next steps to action tracker.
